'''Ralon Nys''' was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He led a team of [[Tempest Squad]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] to arrest an Imperial [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], but he was killed by them inside the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]].
